verdict.rationale: Rollbar's JS SDK explicitly captures breadcrumbs/telemetry timeline (rollbar-gh-1), and docs describe person/user tracking tied to errors (rollbar-docs-20) plus rich stack trace data (rollbar-docs-5), covering much of the story. However there is no explicit documentation of a generic 'custom tags' API or cross-platform consistency for this instrumentation beyond the JS SDK. missing for 10: explicit custom-tags/context API docs, multi-language SDK parity evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of combined breadcrumb+tag+user payloads.
